Manulife uses MongoDB Atlas to increase performance and reduce costs Industry Financial Services Product MongoDB Atlas Use Case Migration Customer since 2018 Data is crucial in the finance industry, especially for investment platforms. For Manulife , transaction data from its iFunds solution is used to power near real-time investment decisions and personalized customer experiences across six markets in Asia.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Manulife's workload.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications and integrations such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS, Google Cloud.
business_outcome: “Delivering solutions better and faster is key in the insurance space,” said Saini.
metrics: “Cost was not a driving factor, but with MongoDB, we got the best solution at a much lower price than other available technologies.” Ingesting data 7.2 times faster at a reduced cost Manulife completed its migration to MongoDB Atlas in 2023.
Manulife’s performance tests, which consisted of a representative dataset of approximately 65 million records, showed the following: Ingestion time was 7.2 times faster.
Read response time was 4.7 ms , — 5.9 times faster than its previous solution.
Data management costs were reduced by 3.5 times.
architecture_clues: The deployment uses a multi-cloud strategy.
Data is replicated across multiple regions for resilience.
High-availability cluster deployment is part of the design.
APIs are a key integration layer in the application architecture.
The deployment integrates with Google Cloud.
